purpose: Remove arbitrary manifest output and broad source inclusion; protect every Node publication subprocess and compare canonical public bytes directly.

newline_correction.method: Normalize only already-proved CRLF equivalents at their existing canonical paths and add explicit LF attributes.

removed_behavior: arbitrary manifest output path and directory/file writer
unbounded 128 MiB Git reader without deadline
bare PATH-selected Node invocations and inherited NODE_* startup settings

current_contract.file_leases: Node and selected tool stay open with FileShare.Read through process exit
current_contract.startup_settings: Remove every NODE_* key only from each child environment; parent environment unchanged
current_contract.termination: Request Windows taskkill for the owned process tree, then verify the owned root process handle has exited even if native stderr raced with termination.

verification.coverage: New generator/bootstrap line and branch coverage was not collected. The existing custody-module instrumentation remains 238/545 commands; it does not quantify new bootstrap coverage.
actual_entrypoints: generator emits current exact metadata to stdout after canonical gate
generator rejects removed output argument with zero stdout/no file
generator refuses stale content commit without rewriting manifest
full 22-file JS output is admitted and materialized identically by the canonical PowerShell module in memory
actual publisher with hostile NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH passes both verified child boundaries then rejects stale manifest before public admission
actual Node timeout verifies terminal root handle and restores PowerShell error preference
memory_only_adversarial_cases: unknown public paths, aliases, links and submodules
same-length Git blob corruption and empty member identities
invalid arguments including a trailing newline on an otherwise valid commit
verification.owned_output: Pester output beneath canonical artifacts/tests physically removed; parent empty.

experimental_findings.observation: The old command could create a manifest at any output path and accepted any file below broad public directory prefixes.
experimental_findings.lesson: Use stdout-only metadata plus a reviewed exact public set and current-file equality; do not rebuild a source stage.

experimental_findings.observation: Twenty Windows public files differed from Git only by CRLF; all source identities matched after line-ending normalization.
experimental_findings.lesson: Make canonical checkout bytes stable with explicit attributes rather than hiding differences in copied packages.

experimental_findings.observation: The initial direct CLI probe lacked service-account safe-directory declarations, so the unchanged canonical source gate rejected Git identity.
experimental_findings.lesson: Use the established per-process declarations for the seven canonical repositories; no global Git setting or source gate was weakened.

experimental_findings.observation: One full run had 63/64 Node passes because native taskkill stderr replaced the expected timeout even though both observed PIDs 47012 and 57808 were subsequently absent.
experimental_findings.lesson: Native termination text can race with process exit. Preserve the timeout failure, inspect the owned process handle afterward and still reject a live child. The corrected full suite passed, including three actual timeout closures.

experimental_findings.observation: Both JavaScript and PowerShell end anchors can match before a final newline.
experimental_findings.lesson: Exact commit parameters also require exactly 40 characters; trailing-newline arguments are now rejected before process execution.

limits: Local metadata and simulated transport are not publication, remote atomicity or outside-network seed evidence.
Timeout tests verified actual Node root termination; a resistant descendant process was not reproduced.
Fresh release identity/authority/manifest preparation, model qualification and hosting remain open.
No new model acquisition, training, model deletion or historical-file deletion.
Existing policy-blocked cleanup groups are unchanged.
